landing.heroTitle: Find your next place to call home
landing.heroSubtitle: Browse listings, save your favorites, and connect directly with owners — all in one simple place.
landing.aboutBody: HomeFind is a straightforward way to buy, rent, or list a property — no agents required. Search by city and price, see everything on an interactive map, save the places you like, and message owners directly when you're ready to talk. Anyone can list a property, whether you're selling your first home or looking to rent out a spare room.
